name: Digital contracts and e-signature
description: Preparing documents, routing them to signers, capturing signatures with evidence, sealing the final PDF, and keeping a verifiable audit trail; with light contract lifecycle management around it.

sources.title: Svix webhooks

sources.notes: Signing/retry design informs webhook delivery. Self-hosting the server is not justified; implement the Standard Webhooks format in NestJS.

sources.title: Standard Webhooks specification
sources.notes: Verified: headers webhook-id, webhook-timestamp (unix seconds), webhook-signature (space-delimited); signed content is id.timestamp.payload; HMAC-SHA256 secrets whsec_+base64; dual-signing for rotation; the spec sets no timestamp tolerance.

sources.title: OWASP Forgot Password Cheat Sheet
sources.notes: Verified: CSPRNG tokens, sufficient length, secure storage, single use, expiry, rate limits; warns account lockout enables DoS, so lock the token or OTP challenge instead.

sources.title: Drizzle ORM row-level security docs
sources.notes: Verified: pgPolicy, pgRole, .withRLS(); default deny with no policy; the app must set the session variable/role inside a transaction.

sources.title: PDF.js (pdfjs-dist)
sources.notes: Browser renderer; also runs on Node with a worker. viewport.convertToPdfPoint handles CropBox and rotation. Set isEvalSupported:false.

sources.title: react-pdf
sources.notes: Thin React wrapper over pdfjs; viewer plus overlay layer for field editing.

sources.title: @cantoo/pdf-lib
sources.notes: Maintained fork of pdf-lib (upstream 1.17.1 last published 2022-05-12). Stamping, merging, AcroForm flattening; loads whole file in memory.

sources.title: @signpdf/signpdf
sources.notes: Placeholder plus detached CMS signing; PAdES-B-B level only. No DSS/VRI (B-LT/LTA is custom work).

sources.title: PKI.js
sources.notes: CMS, TSP (RFC 3161) and OCSP/CRL on WebCrypto. Replaces node-forge (BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0, ASN.1 CVE history).

sources.title: PDFKit
sources.notes: Server-side generation of the completion certificate.

sources.title: signature_pad
sources.notes: Canvas signature capture; use directly rather than react-signature-canvas.

sources.title: pdfme
sources.notes: Only permissive drag-and-drop template/field designer; embeddability in Next.js and per-package licence unchecked.

sources.title: EmbedPDF

sources.title: docusign-esign Node client
sources.notes: Envelope, recipient and tab vocabulary; use only for a DocuSign integration or migration import.

sources.title: mupdf (npm)
sources.notes: Rejected: needs a commercial licence for closed-source SaaS.

sources.title: ISO 32000-2 (PDF 2.0) coordinate model
sources.notes: User space is bottom-left origin in points; visible area is CropBox (defaults to MediaBox); /Rotate applies on top. Basis for storing fields as page-relative fractions. Summary page only; prior knowledge for details.

sources.title: RFC 3161 Time-Stamp Protocol
sources.notes: Trusted timestamp tokens for signed-document evidence. Cited from prior knowledge; not fetched this session.

sources.title: ETSI EN 319 142 (PAdES)
sources.notes: Baseline PAdES levels B-B, B-T, B-LT, B-LTA. Cited from prior knowledge; not fetched this session.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 (eIDAS)
sources.license: EU official legislation; EUR-Lex reuse policy
sources.notes: Distinguishes simple, advanced and qualified electronic signatures and qualified trust services. Not fetched this session; engineering implications only, counsel must confirm.

sources.title: ESIGN Act (15 U.S.C. §7001 et seq.)
sources.notes: Consent to electronic records, intent to sign, record retention and reproducibility. Not fetched this session.

sources.title: Uniform Electronic Transactions Act (UETA)

sources.title: UK: Electronic Identification and Trust Services for Electronic Transactions Regulations 2016; Electronic Communications Act 2000
sources.notes: UK trust-service regime and evidentiary treatment of electronic signatures. Not fetched this session; confidence low, counsel must confirm current text.

sources.title: UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2021 on Electronic Transactions and Trust Services
sources.notes: Recognises electronic signatures, seals and trust services in the UAE. Not fetched this session; confidence low, counsel must confirm.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR)
sources.license: EU official legislation; EUR-Lex reuse policy
sources.notes: Lawful basis, retention limits, erasure vs audit retention, data residency. Same source as other domains; engineering implications only.

sources.notes: Verification checklist for auth, session, access control (IDOR/BOLA), file upload and API security. Cited from prior knowledge; not fetched this session.

features.name: Contract (envelope) management
features.description: [CORE] Create, own, assign, duplicate, cancel, archive and lock contracts; a contract groups documents, recipients, fields and an audit trail. Backend aggregate with optimistic version column for draft edits; list/detail UI with status and owner.

provenance.notes: Envelope/contract aggregate present in Documenso, DocuSeal, OpenSign, LibreSign.

features.name: Contract state machine
features.description: [CORE] Explicit lifecycle draft→sent→in_progress→completed|declined|voided|expired→archived with guarded transitions and an event per transition. Backend: transition table plus DB-level compare-and-set; UI: status badge and timeline.

features.name: Document management
features.description: [CORE] Store, hash, version and serve the PDFs and attachments of a contract behind a file abstraction; immutable versions once sent. Backend: StorageObject + DocumentFile, metadata, upload validation; UI: upload with progress and validation errors.

provenance.notes: Common to all four e-signature repositories inspected.

features.name: Upload validation and malware scanning
features.description: [CORE] Reject non-PDF/allow-listed types by magic-byte sniffing, size/page caps, quarantine until a ClamAV scan is clean, PDF preflight rejecting JavaScript/OpenAction/Launch/EmbeddedFiles. Runs in a sandboxed worker with time and memory limits.

provenance.notes: Reasoned from the OWASP ASVS file-upload section and PDF attack surface; single unfetched authoritative source.

features.name: Document processing pipeline
features.description: [CORE] Queue-driven stages: preflight, scan, render thumbnails, extract text, flatten, stamp, seal, generate certificate. Idempotent BullMQ jobs with deterministic jobId; DB state, not the queue, is the source of truth.

provenance.notes: Reasoned architecture; parts verified against library docs only.

features.name: PDF viewer
features.description: [CORE] Render pages with zoom, page navigation, rotation, thumbnails and minimap. Browser-only pdfjs-dist via react-pdf with a worker; mobile uses PDFium-based pdfrx. Large documents render lazily per page.

provenance.notes: Two independent viewer libraries plus 2 implementations.

features.name: Document preparation
features.description: [CORE] Sender workspace: page thumbnails, field palette, recipient colour coding, properties panel, contextual toolbar, save/resume. Resizable panels layout; autosave with optimistic version.

features.name: Field placement
features.description: [CORE] Drag fields from a palette onto pages, then move, resize, duplicate, snap and align. Store page-relative 0–1 fractions in the unrotated CropBox space; convert to PDF points server-side. dnd-kit for palette drops, pointer events for move/resize.

provenance.notes: Coordinate model from the PDF specification; UX from open-source editors.

features.name: Field types and validation
features.description: [CORE] Signature, initials, text, long text, email, phone, date, date/time, checkbox, radio, dropdown, number, currency, company, job title, attachment; each with a Zod-validated schema, required flag and recipient binding. Normalised field storage with a typed JSON config column for extensibility.

provenance.notes: Field/tab vocabulary matches across Documenso, DocuSeal, OpenSign and the DocuSign SDK.

features.name: Recipient management
features.description: [CORE] Add signers, approvers, CCs and witnesses with role, order, status, internal/external flag and identity requirements; resend, reminder and per-recipient activity. Recipient status derived from events, not edited by hand.

features.name: Signing order and routing
features.description: [CORE] Sequential, parallel and mixed routing groups; optional recipients; the next group is notified only when the previous completes. Advance in the same transaction that records the signature.

features.name: Signature capture
features.description: [CORE] Adopt a signature by drawing (signature_pad), typing (font rendering) or uploading an image; reuse it across fields in one session; store as an image plus the method used. Touch-optimised on mobile.

features.name: Initials capture
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Separate adopted initials reused on per-page initial fields with the same draw/type/upload methods.

features.name: Electronic signing consent
features.description: [CORE] Capture explicit consent to sign electronically and to receive records electronically before any field is shown; store text version, timestamp, IP and user agent. Consent text is versioned per jurisdiction.

provenance.notes: Engineering implication only; statutes not fetched this session. Human legal review required.

features.name: Signing session
features.description: [CORE] Short-lived server session created after token exchange and any verification; carries recipient, contract version, assurance level and device signals; single active session per recipient; next-required-field navigation, progress and completion screen.

features.name: Secure signing tokens
features.description: [CORE] 32-byte CSPRNG base64url tokens; only the SHA-256 is stored; per-recipient expiry, single purpose, revocation and rotation (issue new, revoke old); constant-time compare.

provenance.notes: OWASP token guidance verified; storage design is reasoned.

features.name: One-time-code verification
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Email/SMS OTP challenge: randomInt 6 digits, HMAC-SHA256 with server secret and challenge id, 10-minute TTL, 5 attempts, resend cooldown, per-IP and per-link Redis rate limits, lock the challenge not the account. Do not use a TOTP library for this.

provenance.notes: OWASP reset-token guidance verified; specific TTL/attempt numbers are defaults, not standards.

features.name: Signer identity verification levels
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Assurance ladder per recipient: link-only, email OTP, SMS OTP, access code, then ID document/KYC (see kyc_id_verification). Level recorded in signing evidence and shown on the certificate. Extends shared.identity_verification.

features.name: Email delivery abstraction
features.description: [CORE] Provider-independent EmailProvider interface (SMTP, SES, Postmark, Resend, SendGrid, Mailgun) with template rendering, idempotent sends, retries, and normalised delivery/bounce/complaint events verified per provider signature. Never mark delivered without a provider confirmation.

provenance.notes: Provider event schemas were not verified this session.

features.name: Signing email notifications
features.description: [CORE] Invitations, viewed, signed, completed, declined, voided and expiring emails from versioned, localised templates with variable insertion, sender branding and preview; completed-document delivery with certificate.

features.name: SMS notifications and OTP delivery
features.description: [IMPORTANT] SmsProvider interface (Twilio, Vonage, MessageBird, SNS) for OTP and invitation texts; per-recipient consent, country rules, delivery receipts normalised like email, cost/volume limits.

provenance.notes: Provider receipt schemas not verified; only two repositories inspected.

features.name: In-app notification centre
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Activity inbox for senders: signed, viewed, declined, expiring, bounced, with read state and deep links. Builds on shared.notifications.

features.name: Reminders and expiry
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Scheduled reminder cadence per contract and automatic expiry with a final warning; scheduler creates uniquely-keyed jobs so a reminder is sent at most once per recipient per slot; cancellable on completion.

features.name: Document and contract versioning
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Immutable ContractVersion and DocumentFile rows; edits before send create a new draft version, after send require void-and-recreate or a corrected copy; version list and diff metadata.

provenance.notes: Reasoned; behaviour across repositories not compared file by file.

features.name: Document hashing and integrity
features.description: [CORE] SHA-256 over exact stored bytes on upload, at send, and for the final sealed PDF, streamed; hashes go into the audit trail and certificate; hash verified on every download.

features.name: Final PDF generation
features.description: [CORE] After the last signature, flatten fields, stamp signature images and values, append the completion certificate, then seal once. Runs in exactly one job guarded by a row-level completion claim; uses @cantoo/pdf-lib server-side, never in the browser.

provenance.notes: Repositories all produce a final stamped PDF; library choice verified in npm.

features.name: Immutable signed documents
features.description: [CORE] Sealed PDFs are write-once: object-lock or no-overwrite key policy, new hash on any change, corrected copies are new versions. Deletion only through retention policy.

provenance.notes: S3 object-lock behaviour to be verified against the chosen provider.

features.name: Completion certificate
features.description: [CORE] Appended PDF listing signers, emails, authentication level, IPs, user agents, timestamps, the event list and document hashes, generated with pdfkit. Vendor layouts are unverified; design the layout independently.

provenance.notes: Vendor certificate contents recalled, not fetched.

features.name: Immutable audit trail
features.description: [CORE] Append-only audit events with actor, IP, user agent, correlation id and document hash; REVOKE UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE plus a BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE trigger; per-contract hash chain (prev_hash, hash over canonical JSON) serialised by locking the contract row; no global chain. Extends shared.audit_log.

provenance.notes: Chain design is reasoned; global chain rejected for write hotspot.

features.name: Public verification page
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Public page/API where anyone with the document or a QR code can upload or look up a sealed PDF and see whether its hash matches a stored VerificationRecord, without exposing content. Rate-limited, no enumeration.

provenance.notes: Two repositories; details reasoned.

features.name: Secure downloads
features.description: [CORE] Short-lived pre-signed URLs or a streaming proxy after an authorisation check; Content-Disposition attachment, nosniff, hash check, download audit event; recipients get only their permitted files.

features.name: Storage abstraction (S3-compatible)
features.description: [CORE] StorageProvider interface over S3/R2/MinIO with tenant-prefixed keys, server-side encryption, multipart uploads, lifecycle policies and object lock support; builds on shared.file_storage.

features.name: Webhooks
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Per-organisation endpoints and event subscriptions; Standard Webhooks signing (id.timestamp.payload HMAC-SHA256), whsec_ secrets, dual secrets during rotation, SSRF-safe URL validation.

provenance.notes: Spec verified; Svix and Documenso independent implementations.

features.name: Webhook retry and dead-letter
features.description: [IMPORTANT] BullMQ exponential backoff with jitter over days, per-attempt delivery log, terminal failed state as dead-letter, manual redrive, replay protection with a 5-minute timestamp tolerance (spec sets none).

features.name: Search and filtering
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Contract search by name, number, recipient, email, company, reference and metadata using Postgres tsvector + GIN and pg_trgm; filter by status, date, owner, template; URL-state filters. External engine only if measured too slow. Builds on shared.search.

provenance.notes: Postgres adequacy is reasoned, not benchmarked.

features.name: Exports and reports
features.description: [IMPORTANT] CSV/PDF export of contracts, audit events and activity with tenant scoping, async jobs for large sets and expiring download links. Extends shared.import_export.

features.name: Templates
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Reusable documents with named recipient roles, pre-placed fields and variables; draft/published/archived workflow, versioning, variable picker and preview; create contract from template.

features.name: Organisation branding
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Logo, colours, sender name and email domain applied to signing pages and emails with contrast checks; custom domain optional.

features.name: RBAC and permission overrides
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Organisation roles with per-contract or per-template overrides (view, edit, send, void); authorisation on every mutation at the object level, not only the route. Extends shared.permissions.

features.name: Multi-tenancy and isolation
features.description: [CORE] Tenant context via AsyncLocalStorage (nestjs-cls), one transactional wrapper that sets app.tenant_id with set_config(...,true) under a non-owner role, Postgres RLS as defence in depth, tenant in every job payload and storage/cache/search key, tenant scoped webhook secrets.

provenance.notes: Drizzle RLS behaviour verified; pooling behaviour of set_config must be tested per driver.

features.name: Concurrency control and idempotency
features.description: [CORE] Sign in a transaction with SELECT … FOR UPDATE on the contract, count remaining signers, so exactly one transaction sees last signer; unique(recipient_id) on signature; Idempotency-Key table unique(tenant,key); jobId dedupe is a hint, not the guarantee; optimistic version only for draft edits.

provenance.notes: Reasoned patterns; a single implementation read; needs concurrency tests.

features.name: Rate limiting and anti-abuse
features.description: [CORE] Redis limits per IP, token, recipient, tenant and endpoint; OTP and public-verification throttling; upload quotas; bot challenge on public links; abuse events to security log.

features.name: Security events
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Dedicated stream for failed OTPs, token reuse, revoked-link access, cross-tenant denials, webhook signature failures and admin actions with alerting hooks; feeds SIEM.

features.name: Admin security settings
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Organisation settings for allowed verification levels, MFA/SSO enforcement, IP allow-lists, session lifetime, API keys, retention and webhook secrets; changes audited.

features.name: Observability
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Structured logs with correlation ids, OpenTelemetry traces across API, queue and worker, queue depth and job-failure metrics, alerts on stuck completion jobs; never log tokens or document content. Extends shared.logging.

provenance.notes: Reasoned.

features.name: Internationalisation and RTL
features.description: [IMPORTANT] English and Persian: next-intl, Tailwind logical utilities, Vazirmatn for Persian, Intl for numbers/dates/calendars (fa-IR-u-ca-persian), translated validation messages, per-recipient signing language; audit trail stays UTC/ISO. PDF field coordinates never flip with UI direction. Extends shared.i18n.

provenance.notes: Library choices from a research agent; not verified against docs.

features.name: GDPR and retention
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Per-tenant retention policy, scheduled deletion of documents and evidence, data export and erasure reconciled with audit retention, legal hold overrides, lawful-basis and consent records. Technical considerations only.

provenance.notes: Statute not fetched this session; requires human legal review.

features.name: Legal hold
features.description: [OPTIONAL] Freeze deletion of selected contracts and evidence regardless of retention policy, with reason, actor and release audit.

provenance.notes: Reasoned inference.

features.name: Data residency
features.description: [FUTURE] Per-tenant region for storage, database and processing; region-aware endpoints and job routing.

provenance.notes: Reasoned.

features.name: Billing readiness
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Metering of sent envelopes, SMS and storage per tenant, plan entitlements and quota enforcement hooks so billing can be attached later. Builds on shared.billing.

features.name: Public API, API keys and sandbox
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Versioned REST API with OpenAPI, scoped hashed API keys, idempotency keys, cursor pagination, error envelope, sandbox tenant and SDK examples; webhooks documented alongside.

features.name: Domain testing strategy
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Reusable tests and fixtures for tenant isolation, authorisation, state transitions, concurrent signing, idempotency, token reuse, OTP abuse, upload attacks, webhook replay, PDF correctness (rotated and CropBox-offset PDFs), email/SMS retries and job failures.

provenance.notes: Reasoned.

features.name: Backup and disaster recovery
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Database PITR plus object-storage versioning and cross-region copy of sealed documents; documented restore drills and integrity re-verification of hashes after restore.

provenance.notes: Reasoned.

features.name: Mobile signing
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Responsive web signing and a Flutter signing flow: touch signature, sticky bottom actions, progress, field-to-field navigation, OTP entry, biometric app unlock, secure token storage, completion screen.

provenance.notes: Flutter package maintenance was not verified.

features.name: Decline, void and correct
features.description: [IMPORTANT] Signer declines with a reason; sender voids with reason and notifies recipients; corrections create a new version and re-route. All are terminal transitions with audit events and webhooks.

features.name: Delegation and reassign
features.description: [OPTIONAL] A recipient delegates to another person or the sender reassigns before signing; old token revoked, new identity checked, chain of custody recorded.

features.name: Witness and in-person signing
features.description: [OPTIONAL] Witness recipients countersign; in-person mode hands the device to a signer on the sender's session with host authentication.

features.name: Bulk send
features.description: [OPTIONAL] Send one template to many recipients from a CSV with per-row validation, throttled queue and a batch report.

features.name: Public signing links
features.description: [OPTIONAL] Self-service link/QR where anyone fills and signs a template (forms, waivers), with bot protection and per-link quotas; each submission becomes a contract.

features.name: Conditional and calculated fields
features.description: [OPTIONAL] Show/require fields based on other values; computed numbers and formulas evaluated with a safe expression evaluator, never eval.

features.name: Attachment requests
features.description: [OPTIONAL] Signer uploads supporting documents (ID, proof) into the contract through an attachment field with the same upload security as sender files.

features.name: Embedded signing
features.description: [OPTIONAL] Signing UI embeddable in a customer app via short-lived session URL and postMessage events, with CSP frame-ancestors allow-list.

features.name: SSO and SCIM provisioning
features.description: [OPTIONAL] SAML/OIDC login and SCIM user provisioning for organisations. Depends on shared.auth; connectors delegated to an existing SSO layer.

features.name: Approval workflow
features.description: [OPTIONAL] Internal approvers review a draft before it is sent to external signers; approve/reject with comments as a routing step.

features.name: Comments and collaboration
features.description: [OPTIONAL] Threaded comments on a contract or a field between internal users, mentions and notifications; never visible to external signers unless shared.

features.name: Contract repository and renewals
features.description: [OPTIONAL] Metadata (counterparty, value, dates), expiry and renewal reminders, folders and tags for completed contracts: a light CLM layer over the signed archive.

features.name: Advanced and qualified signatures
features.description: [FUTURE] Interface-only extension point for AdES/QES: SignatureProvider, KMS/HSM key custody, trust-service-provider integration, PAdES-B-B via signpdf, RFC 3161 timestamps via pkijs, B-LT/LTA as custom work. No fake certificates or hand-rolled crypto.

provenance.notes: Interfaces only. Legal level (SES/AdES/QES) must be decided with counsel.

features.name: Document and KYC verification
features.description: [FUTURE] Provider-based ID document and liveness check before signing, result stored as evidence reference not raw images; consent and retention limits. Extends shared.identity_verification.

features.name: AI contract intelligence
features.description: [FUTURE] Optional capabilities using the kit's ai/ layer: summarisation, clause extraction, risk flags, metadata and template-variable extraction, OCR, classification, semantic search, comparison, missing-signature detection, anomaly detection. Off by default, per-tenant opt-in, no training on tenant content.

provenance.notes: Reasoned product ideas; no implementation source.
